findings.claim: pcr.py is now the first library module to drift from the extraction seed, and this was not recorded in CHANGES.md or README.md at the time this finding was raised. seed-manifest.json pins the pre-seam bytes; README.md states the six library modules were extracted byte-for-byte from that seed.
findings.evidence: Hashing each src/pyto/<name>.py against its seed-manifest entry gives __init__.py, core.py, graph.py, neon.py and pql.py = match, and pcr.py = pre-seam sha -> post-seam sha (investigation.py is ABSENT by design). So library-module drift is 1 today, where it was 0 at d9dded6. research/ULTRACODE-WEEK.md schedules a seed-manifest drift refresh for Day 5.
findings.required_fix: Record in CHANGES.md's Day 2 section that this is the first library module to leave the extraction seed, so Day 5's drift refresh starts from a written record rather than a rediscovery.
findings.short_summary: pcr.py's seed-manifest drift is real but deferred to Day 5 per plan
